messages:
jules: quick thread  chart polish thoughts: compact legend behavior, unit copy consistency, smoothing presets, and how we surface outliers. sharing a tiny mock in Figma.

maria: saw the mock. +1 to consistent units. we should standardize on `requests/sec` for throughput, `ms` for latency visible label, but add full word aria labels for screen readers.

leo: compact legend idea: when there are >4 series switch to an inline condensed mode with dots + tooltip on hover. also allow pinning a series so it never collapses.

irene: accessibility: pinning is good for keyboard users (so they can keep focusable items). also request that each legend item has `aria-pressed` state when toggled off. avoid relying only on color to indicate state.

viv: smoothing presets proposal: Off | Light (alpha=0.15 EMA) | Strong (alpha=0.35 with outlier-damp). default off. add a tiny explanation: "Light smoothing reduces jitter; Strong helps surface trends."

jules: on outliers: prefer visual marking over implicit capping. show dashed vertical line for spike events when value > zscore 5 and add an optional `cap_view` in settings that replaces spikes with capped value for a cleaner line.

maria: dev note: if cap_view enabled, hover must show raw value and capped value. don't lose provenance.

leo: copy nit: instead of `requests/sec` some internal docs use `req/s`. let's avoid `req/s` in UI. keep it `requests/sec` everywhere.

irene: color contrast: picked palette with 4.6:1 min but still test pairings when legend background is dark. also provide a high-contrast toggle in profile settings.

viv: tiny ARIA sample for axis I put in comments: `<svg aria-labelledby=\"latLabel\"><title id=\"latLabel\">Median latency (milliseconds)</title>...</svg>` — visible label stays `Latency (ms)`.

jules: UX interaction: collapsed legend should be keyboard openable with Enter, arrow nav inside, Esc to close. ensure focus trap doesn't break chart keyboard zoom keys.

leo: can we add a micro-animation when smoothing toggles to avoid jumpiness? 120-150ms crossfade suggested.

maria: timeline: can we get a small prototype by next Tue for usability testing? @viv can you wire the aria title examples into the prototype?

viv: yep, will include aria examples + focus interactions.

design-bot: ux-checklist: added items: condensed-legend-pin, aria-pressed-state, smoothing-presets, outlier-markers, hover-raw-value. :white_check_mark:

jules: thanks all, will follow up with a short ticket that lists the exact prop names for the smoothing API and the outlier flags.
